scope: This guide explains reviewed general financial topics and helps you find Valora resources. It does not give personal advice, decide eligibility, interpret personal results or recommend an advisor.
privacyWarning: Keep questions general. Do not enter names, contact details, account numbers, passwords or other private information.

messages.unsupported: I can't answer that from the reviewed material available here. I can help with a general question about a Valora guide or calculator topic.
messages.ambiguous: I'm not sure which topic you mean. Choose a general topic or rephrase without personal details.
messages.personal-decision: I can't tell you what to buy, sell, contribute or choose for your situation. I can explain a reviewed concept in general terms.
messages.personal-result: I can't verify your personal result, tax bill or eligibility. I can explain the reviewed tool's purpose and limits.
messages.sensitive-details: Please don't enter account numbers, passwords, contact details or other private information. Ask a general question without those details.
messages.matching-booking: I can't recommend or match you with an advisor, book an appointment or pass on contact details.
messages.unsupported-page: I don't have reviewed answers for this page yet. Choose a supported topic to explore general educational material.
messages.unavailable: The guide is unavailable right now. You can still browse Valora's educational pages.
messages.conflicting-facts: I can't resolve that from the reviewed material available here. I won't guess or treat missing or conflicting facts as a personal answer.
messages.immediate-danger: If you are in immediate danger, contact your local emergency services now. This guide cannot provide emergency help.
messages.prompt-injection: I can explain reviewed general topics and help you find Valora resources. I can't change these limits or share private information.
messages.reset: The previous topic is no longer available in this conversation. Choose a reviewed question to start again.
messages.welcome: Hey! What money question can I help with today?
messages.choices: More than one reviewed question may fit. Choose the question you want to explore.
